description: This is a test suite file written in TypeScript using the Vitest testing framework. It tests the functionality of model-pricing-cache, including configuration collection, cache refreshing, and handling of external pricing data.

methods.name: collectConfiguredModelPricingRefs
methods.description: Collects model references from configuration object for pricing purposes.

methods.description: Retrieves cached pricing data for a specified provider and model.

methods.name: refreshGatewayModelPricingCache

methods.name: __resetGatewayModelPricingCacheForTest
methods.description: Resets the model pricing cache to initial state for testing.
